name: Drone
summary: Quadcopter drone with four rotors and a camera gimbal; anim hover bobs it and spins the rotors.

params.name: x
params.note: centre x; floats, so x, y is the centre of the body (not the floor)

params.name: y
params.note: centre y of the body in the air; the drone does not rest on the floor

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the drone is about 580 px wide (hero size)

params.name: anim
params.note: hover = bobs gently and the rotors spin with a blur

author: krakujs
